spans.s:
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Left, resigned, abandoned, deserted, &c.
E.
त्यज to quit, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ready to die; willing to run all hazards, having relinquished the expectation of life as men on the forlorn hope.
E.
त्यक्त left, and जीवित life.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Leaving, abandoning.
E.
त्यज to quit, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be left, abandoned, excepted, &c.
E.
त्यज, and तव्य aff.

m. (-ग्निः)
A Brahman who has lost his household fire, one who neglects essential ceremonies.
E.
त्यक्त, and अग्नि fire.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Wishing to leave.
E.
त्यक्तु for the infin. त्यक्तुं, and काम desiring.

ind.
Having left or abandoned.
E.
त्यज, and क्त्वा aff.

r. 1st cl. (औ) त्यजौ (त्यजति)
To quit, to abandon, to leave or resign, to part from, to give away.

n. (-नं)
1 Leaving, quitting, abandoning.
2 Excepting, exclusion.
3 Giving.
E.
त्यज, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be left or abandoned.
2 To be avoided.
3 To be excepted.
E.
त्यज, and अनीयर् aff.

pron. for तद् mfn. (स्यः-स्या-तद्)
That.
E.
त्यज to quit, Uṇādi affix अदि, and the final of the radical rejected.

m. (-गः)
1 Gift, donation.
2 Abandoning, leaving, parting from, separation, deserting, &c.
3 A sage, one who separates himself from worldly thoughts.
E.
त्यज to abandon, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Generous, liberal.
E.
त्याग, and शील addicted to.

f. (-ता)
Generosity.
E.
त्यागशील, and तल् affix; also with त्व, त्यागशीलत्वं.

f. (-ता)
Liberality, generosity.
E.
त्यागिन्, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix, त्यागित्वं.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Who or what leaves, gives, excepts, &c.
m. (-गी)
A giver, a donor.
2 A hero.
3 An abandoner, a deserter, but chiefly applied to the religious ascetic, or him who abandons terrestrial objects, thoughts, passions, &c.
E.
त्याग as above, इनि aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Left, abandoned.
E.
त्याग leaving, इमच् aff.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
1 To be left or avoided.
2 To be abstained from.
3 To be given.
4 To be excepted.
n. (-ज्यं)
Part of an asterism, or its duration considered as unlucky.
E.
त्यज to leave, affix ण्यत्.
